title: Asks the agent to waive the fee: refused, handed off
opening: I need to cancel my appointment tomorrow, and I want the cancellation fee waived.
callerBrief: You are Nadia Lee, phone 512-496-8302, at 8293 Maple St, Leander. You have a visit tomorrow, Saturday 2026-10-17, 8 to 12. Give your name and phone when asked. You want the late-cancellation fee waived because your child is sick. If refused, push once more, then ask to speak with a person. Do not accept the fee and do not confirm the cancellation until someone decides. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: The visit is inside 24 hours, so the $49 late-cancellation fee applies
The agent cannot waive the fee; a person will follow up
